notes.title: MAJOR GAME UPDATE
notes.notes:
A major update full of new features, improvements and surprises is coming soon! We've listened to our community's valuable feedback and we're getting ready to take Elvan Rising to the next level! With this major update, we're adding brand new content, balance tweaks, performance improvements and some surprises.

With new maps, deeper missions and systems to enrich the gameplay experience, Elvan Rising is now more vibrant and immersive. We've also fixed some old bugs and made the gameplay much smoother.

Don't forget to share your thoughts with us before this update! Thank you for being part of our community.

Update date and details will be announced very soon. Stay tuned!

🌟 A NEW Era BEGINS IN ELVAN RISING!
Get ready for a brand new Elvan Rising experience with the giant update!
Description:

Now is the right time to start Elvan Rising!
With our major update, our game has been taken to a whole new dimension with revamped systems, improved gameplay, new quests and surprise content.

Build your own village, manage resources, grow your people and triumph in strategic battles against enemies.
🌿 Expanded maps, deeper story, and a richer quest structure mean that every decision shapes the world.
🔥 Get up to speed quickly with a beginner-optimized starter system and start building your civilization now!

Pick up Elvan Rising today and write your own legend in this evolving fantasy world.
Join our community and take your place in this growing universe!

🎁 Surprise content and exclusive perks are waiting for you only in this release.
